more.good_when: A developer who builds hand-over or pieces, or writes their test cases, finds in the document which part looks at the earlier branches and worktrees when a new piece takes its number, and which pieces the status lists and counts in its share once overnight has run on more than one night, so no developer has to ask or guess either.
